name: Irouléguy

limits: For rosé wine, Cabernet Franc, Cabernet Sauvignon and Tannat together: at least 90%
For red wine, Cabernet Franc and Tannat together: at least 50%
For red wine, Cabernet Franc and Tannat, each: at most 90%

climate.koppen_name: Temperate, no dry season, warm summer

terms: France's protected place names. A wine sold under one must follow that appellation's rules. The EU's term for the same tier is PDO, or AOP in French.

blurb.text: A South West France appellation, the only one in the Northern Basque Country and often called one of the smallest vineyards in France.
